feature_contract.goal: Keep original in-game HUD speed/time/position and exact +TIME/rank SpriteNode semantic ownership attached to the correct visible frame during cross-thread queue production; prevent a future frame's tag from head-locking the current draw.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only producer-to-queued-D3D9 GPU render-owner generation lifetime for existing HUD and exact rank/+TIME primitives. No broad alpha/ScreenOverlay promotion, SkyGlow, GOAL animation changes, input/FFB, desktop menu/ESC, R26_SAFE fallback or DXVK.
trace_stages: Original source hooks tag speed/time/rank and +TIME SpriteNodes with exact scope and producer on the shared registration thread.
R23/R64 queue rendering snapshots an immutable tag serial cutoff, but old Peek/Consume paths could read a later producer's tag from an overlapping next-frame registration.

R84 GPU owner now admits only queue-era tags consistently across D3DX Peek→RenderScope/producer and physical queue Consume; next queue walk retains and uses later owner instead of relabeling the current left/right eye.
subcomponents: Enforce the existing queue Begin serial fence in both exact producer Peek and Consume, retaining locked registry lifetime and negative-bit hint correctness across frames.
Preserve already-present HUD/marker +TIME ownership during old queue walk, and guarantee next-frame queued rank and +TIME source declarations cannot leak into previous draw or be lost on End.
Run native Release/NDEBUG-enabled semantic smoke for current/new tag including XYZRHW vehicle marker depth identity, preserve good queue-end cleanup and cross-thread mutation guard.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Cross-thread shared SpriteNodeSemanticTags read by canonical queue while next-frame producers can publish independently; queue Begin captures serial but Peek and Consume did not check it.
source_trace: Original HUD/StageExtensionTime/RANK tags published under mutex by RegisterSpriteNodeScope with monotonically increasing serial.
Queue BeginSpriteQueueRender/SelectSpriteQueueNode captures producer serial cutoff, while PeekSpriteNodeScope/ConsumeSpriteNodeScope accepted any exact-pointer tag even from beyond it.
R84 per-eye GPU draw classifies CurrentRenderProducerToken and EffectiveScope based on that queue tag; wrong generation could select ScreenHud or projected rank on an old current draw.
diagnosis.root_cause: Actual code-path cross-frame semantic-read race: producer future serial passes pointer/tag lookup despite active frame cutoff, yielding wrong HUD/rank per-eye ownership. Hardware symptom linkage remains untested.
alternatives_rejected: Do not clear entire global registry at queue End or relabel world alpha as ScreenHud; existing after-cutoff cleanup already preserves new tags, so read-side admission must respect it.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Both locked PeekSpriteNodeScope and ConsumeSpriteNodeScope now reject serial greater than current queue cutoff and retain future tag and hint; old tagged sources remain accepted.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Changed existing semantic-tag-hint Release smoke to always run EXPECT even under NDEBUG; added old/new +TIME cursor and next-frame rank anchor cases; updated source mutation verifier for both tag-read gates.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Exact per-frame GameSemantic CurrentQueue producer gates R84 c64/XYZRHW per-eye classification; future rank car view depth and +TIME ScreenHud cannot rebind current-frame eye source.

runtime_evidence: No real Quest3/VDXR headset test on the exact build; HUD optic/stereo acceptance still UNTESTED.
